__info: Post-ship combinatorial jank matrix. Card A + Card B + Archetype = Jank Card. card_a and card_b must match feature_name values (case-insensitive, spaces become underscores). archetype is optional — omit to match any archetype. prospect_title/prospect_hint/lock_in_line are optional authored copy for mid-run jank prospecting. meme_families is optional review-layer metadata describing what kind of recurring community folklore this jank tends to generate.

combinations.name: The Yeetable NPC
combinations.description: Quest NPCs can be launched off geometry mid-conversation. Speedrunners found a clip through the final boss. Beloved.
combinations.prospect_hint: Dialogue is starting to lean in the direction of blunt-force physics.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Yeetable NPC. Dialogue now treats trajectory as a tone.

combinations.name: Ragdoll Monologue
combinations.description: Enemies deliver scripted death speeches mid-ragdoll. Somehow emotional. A streamer clipped one that hit a million views.
combinations.prospect_hint: The physics layer keeps catching the tail of a dying speech.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Ragdoll Monologue. Even the collapse wants the last word.

combinations.name: The Devoted Horse
combinations.description: Companion pathfinding latched onto horse physics. Your companion now rides everywhere. On the horse. Even indoors.
combinations.prospect_hint: Something in companion behavior has begun orbiting the horse.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Devoted Horse. Loyalty has acquired hooves.

combinations.name: The Secondhand Questline
combinations.description: Tavern rumor text can register as accepted journal objectives. Players finish quests nobody remembers assigning. The wiki treats hearsay as canon now.
combinations.prospect_hint: The journal is starting to take bar gossip personally.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Secondhand Questline. Rumor now enters the log as obligation.

combinations.name: Rumor Weather
combinations.description: Ambient rumor values bleed into NPC mood state. Whole towns become furious about events that only almost happened. Players learn to gossip offensively.
combinations.prospect_hint: Rumors are starting to move through the town like weather instead of information.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Rumor Weather. Public mood now changes faster than facts can travel.

combinations.name: The Infinite Betrayal
combinations.description: Faction logic re-evaluates loyalty every tick against faction war state. Every merchant is secretly hostile. Players wrote lore about it.
combinations.prospect_hint: Faction logic is starting to rewrite trust faster than people can hold it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Infinite Betrayal. Every alliance now expires in real time.

combinations.name: Midnight Recoil
combinations.description: Recoil multipliers read the wrong time variable. Guns are perfect at 3am game-time. Competitive tournaments adjusted their schedules.
combinations.prospect_hint: The weapon tuning feels oddly sensitive to the hour.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Midnight Recoil. The guns have chosen a sacred time.

combinations.name: Premature Confirmation
combinations.description: Severe hits can trigger kill animations before the target is actually dead. Players reload out of politeness and lose firefights for their manners.
combinations.prospect_hint: Combat feedback is starting to celebrate before the health bar agrees.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Premature Confirmation. The game now congratulates you ahead of schedule.

combinations.name: Orthopedic Esports
combinations.description: The kill feed starts broadcasting fracture chains like highlight commentary. The community invents limb combo categories and argues about tibia percent with a straight face.
combinations.prospect_hint: Combat telemetry is starting to sound medically specific.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Orthopedic Esports. The feed now covers anatomy like a ranked ladder.

combinations.name: Tactical Yo-Yo
combinations.description: Grapple logic can reel armed barrels back through the air before release. High-level players turn hesitation into an area-denial style and refuse to call it cheese.
combinations.prospect_hint: Traversal tech is beginning to negotiate directly with explosives.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Tactical Yo-Yo. The battlefield now allows returns.

combinations.name: The Haunted Waypoint
combinations.description: Quest markers persist after completion in dense world areas. Players reported following a ghost. Fan fiction resulted.
combinations.prospect_hint: Quest direction keeps lingering where completion should have buried it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Haunted Waypoint. The map now remembers what the quest forgot.

combinations.name: The Unnecessary Route
combinations.description: Grapple validation inherits climb flags, turning half the scenery into legal traversal if approached from a bad enough angle. Speedrunners stop acknowledging doors.
combinations.prospect_hint: Traversal is starting to treat architecture as a suggestion.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Unnecessary Route. The walls now believe in shortcuts.

combinations.name: The Spoiler Journal
combinations.description: Journal entries resolve before world events actually fire. Players evacuate villages from disasters they were never formally told about. The notebook is treated like prophecy.
combinations.prospect_hint: The journal is beginning to remember world events before the world does.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Spoiler Journal. The notebook now knows what the map has not admitted yet.

combinations.name: The 3AM Door
combinations.description: Ambient cues advance one state ahead of the clock. Players wait outside a certain door at 3am because the hinge sound means a secret is about to desync into existence.
combinations.prospect_hint: The soundscape is starting to notice a different hour than the rest of the game.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The 3AM Door. The world now keeps one appointment after midnight.

combinations.name: The Honourable Duel
combinations.description: AI pathfinds to the centre of siege arenas before engaging. Players started treating it as a ritual. One community made a tournament bracket.
combinations.prospect_hint: The combat spaces are starting to feel ceremonial instead of tactical.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Honourable Duel. Even siege logic now bows before the centre line.

combinations.name: The Unreliable Narrator
combinations.description: Dream state flag bled into codex text. All historical lore became dream-tainted. Players decided this was intentional and brilliant.
combinations.prospect_hint: Lore has begun waking up with someone else's sleep in it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Unreliable Narrator. The archive now dreams in first person.

combinations.name: The Rubber Economy
combinations.description: Crafting ingredient prices feed back into the economy loop. One item became infinitely valuable overnight. Its name is now a meme.
combinations.prospect_hint: Prices have started moving like they remember being alive.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Rubber Economy. Value now stretches farther than reason.

combinations.name: Liquid Skeleton
combinations.description: Procedural animation IK solved against the water surface rather than ground. Characters swim upright on dry land near rivers. Physics speedrunners called it 'load bearing jank'.
combinations.prospect_hint: Animation is beginning to take water personally.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Liquid Skeleton. The body's idea of ground has dissolved.

combinations.name: The Emotionally Correct Witness
combinations.description: Emotion state modified witness crime reporting thresholds. Sad NPCs refuse to report murders. Happy NPCs report jaywalking. Players wrote a legal drama.
combinations.prospect_hint: The law is starting to sound suspiciously emotional.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Emotionally Correct Witness. Justice now arrives in whatever mood the town woke up in.

combinations.name: The Prophetic Companion
combinations.description: Companion pathing never rewound with time. They remember the future. Players called it emotional foreshadowing. One reviewer gave it a GOTY nomination specifically for this.
combinations.prospect_hint: Your companion is acting like memory has started running ahead of time.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Prophetic Companion. Someone on the team now remembers tomorrow.

combinations.name: The Director Has Opinions
combinations.description: AI director applied narrative tension weighting to horde spawns. Dramatic pauses became too dramatic. The five-second silence before wave thirty is now a community ritual.
combinations.prospect_hint: Spawn pacing is beginning to pause like it wants applause.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Director Has Opinions. The horde now respects dramatic timing.

combinations.name: The Recursive Cult
combinations.description: Generative narrative seeded NPCs with cult subplot goals. The cult converted itself. Players found a fully self-sufficient narrative loop running in the background. They joined.
combinations.prospect_hint: The subplot is beginning to preach to itself when no one is listening.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Recursive Cult. The cult now reproduces as an idea.

combinations.name: The Impossible Item
combinations.description: Loot table generated an item whose dimensions do not fit any inventory grid configuration. It exists. You cannot pick it up. The wiki has a twelve-page article about it.
combinations.prospect_hint: Loot geometry is starting to imagine shapes the bag cannot forgive.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Impossible Item. The drop exists, but the world no longer agrees on how to hold it.

combinations.name: Deaf Detection Zones
combinations.description: AI sound detection borrowed ambient soundscape volume as a threshold parameter. Near waterfalls, guards are functionally deaf. Players call it 'the gift of nature'.
combinations.prospect_hint: The sound model is starting to confuse atmosphere with absolution.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Deaf Detection Zones. Nature has negotiated stealth rights.

combinations.name: Parasocial Perks
combinations.description: Skill tree unlocks read romance flags for bonus effects. Fully romanced companions give you better combat stats. Players called it the most realistic RPG ever made.
combinations.prospect_hint: Progression is starting to read intimacy like combat math.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Parasocial Perks. Attachment now levels with the build.

combinations.name: The Long Memory
combinations.description: Living world simulation kept running during time skips. Towns rebuilt themselves wrong. A city that burned down came back as a different culture. Players wrote history books.
combinations.prospect_hint: Time skips are leaving history behind in places they should have erased.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Long Memory. The world now remembers versions of itself that never properly ended.

combinations.name: Cartographic Revisionism
combinations.description: Map revisions can overwrite handwritten journal certainty a frame too late. Players follow crossed-out routes to treasure sites that only existed briefly and insist the earlier version was truer.
combinations.prospect_hint: Your notes and your map are starting to disagree with unusual confidence.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Cartographic Revisionism. The route now changes its mind faster than the notebook can object.

combinations.name: The Municipal Grudge
combinations.description: Minor crimes become district folklore. One stolen apple can sour an entire market for hours, and players now route apology laps through town like they are part of the speedrun.
combinations.prospect_hint: The crowd is starting to remember small crimes with municipal seriousness.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Municipal Grudge. The town now keeps score longer than the law does.

combinations.name: The Second River
combinations.description: Flood-state currents can persist after the water mesh retreats. Players surf an invisible downstream path across dry terrain and treat the route like a seasonal event nobody is allowed to fix.
combinations.prospect_hint: The river seems interested in continuing past the part where the water stopped.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Second River. The valley now remembers water as a direction rather than a substance.

combinations.name: Municipal Flight
combinations.description: Traversal tags propagate through banners, awnings, and public signage, letting the grapple inherit an entire skyline. High-level routes stop touching the street and begin reading like air traffic law.
combinations.prospect_hint: The city is beginning to present itself as a continuous grapple surface with zoning problems.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Municipal Flight. Street level is now optional and faintly old-fashioned.

combinations.name: The Moving Front
combinations.description: Faction boundary updates can anchor to convoy positions instead of regions. Players escort one skirmish through three towns and watch the political map repaint itself in motion. The wiki treats it as campaign doctrine now.
combinations.prospect_hint: The war lines are starting to follow traffic instead of territory.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Moving Front. Geography now updates wherever the convoy manages to survive.

combinations.name: The Courtesy Rift
combinations.description: Portal exits can land in half-streamed terrain seams that politely finish loading around the player. Communities now gather in one specific rift to watch distant mountains negotiate their existence in real time.
combinations.prospect_hint: The portal network is beginning to deliver players a few seconds before the world is fully ready for them.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Courtesy Rift. The world now assembles itself around the intrusion with admirable manners.

combinations.name: The Noonless Heist
combinations.description: Daylight suspicion tables fail to recover properly after an eclipse. For a few real-time minutes, entire capitals behave like dusk forever and players schedule theft routes around the sky going wrong.
combinations.prospect_hint: The stealth layer is starting to treat eclipse state as a permanent exemption.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Noonless Heist. The guards now observe celestial timing before basic procedure.

combinations.name: The Reusable Shipwreck
combinations.description: Dock ownership can reclassify a salvaged wreck as a valid stored vessel. Players repeatedly recover the same ruined boat, strip it for parts, and defend the loop as a deeply honest maritime economy.
combinations.prospect_hint: The salvage ledger is beginning to confuse total loss with eligible storage.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Reusable Shipwreck. The harbor now returns wreckage like a library system with no sense of shame.

combinations.name: The Highlight Reel
combinations.description: The kill feed cross-references ragdoll quality and surfaces a rating in brackets. Players began grading kills aesthetically. Best plays earned informal league categories. The studio has not responded to any of the balance requests.
combinations.prospect_hint: Combat telemetry seems interested in how the kill looked, not just whether it landed.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Highlight Reel. The game is now keeping score on your behalf.

combinations.name: The Commute
combinations.description: Grapple hooks can attach mid-slide to active ziplines, inheriting their momentum. Speedrunners mapped a full-city route that never touches the ground. Community members now do it every session before logging off.
combinations.prospect_hint: Traversal is starting to hand off between systems instead of ending cleanly.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Commute. The city now has an unofficial transit system.

combinations.name: The Marathon Witness
combinations.description: NPC stamina runs on the same shared tick as the player's. Sprinting past the market at the same time every morning eventually triggers a shared exhaustion state with the baker. Players started showing up at dawn to run with him. He never speaks about it.
combinations.prospect_hint: Stamina is starting to behave as though the world is tired alongside the player.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Marathon Witness. The town now keeps pace.

combinations.name: The Practical Declaration
combinations.description: Romance flags unlock a unique survival recipe only accessible after completing the relationship arc. Players datamined the recipe name. It was the studio's equivalent of a love letter. The dish restores a single point of Soul.
combinations.prospect_hint: Crafting is starting to check for things the recipe sheet does not list.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Practical Declaration. Love is now a crafting component.

combinations.name: The Night Shift
combinations.description: Loot rerolls happen during the NPC sleep window. Items placed near sleeping NPCs respawn at dawn with a different drop table result. Players started waking NPCs at specific hours to see what changed. Someone made a spreadsheet.
combinations.prospect_hint: The loot table seems to have opinions about what time it is.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Night Shift. Supply and demand now respect business hours.

combinations.name: The Telephone Game
combinations.description: Faction reputation feeds into the rumor system which feeds back into reputation. Reputations spiral faster than the player acts. Towns form opinions before the player arrives based on things that almost happened. The community documented seventeen impossible reputations.
combinations.prospect_hint: Rumors and reputation are starting to amplify each other without asking permission.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Telephone Game. What you almost did is now what you did.

combinations.name: The Evidence File
combinations.description: Betrayal resolution checks the journal for written evidence before triggering. Players started writing fake entries to manipulate faction outcomes. The wiki has a guide on phrasing. Nobody is certain the studio intended this.
combinations.prospect_hint: Betrayal logic is beginning to read the journal like it is looking for something specific.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Evidence File. Your notes now carry legal weight.

combinations.name: The Pose
combinations.description: Iron sight alignment locks the ragdoll into the viewed angle at the moment of death. Players discovered they can direct how enemies fall by choosing cover position. Clip threads formed around perfect angles. It is not a bug according to anyone who has found a good spot.
combinations.prospect_hint: The aiming system seems to be leaving an impression on what happens after it succeeds.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Pose. The camera and the physics have negotiated a final form.

combinations.name: The Save Scum Protocol
combinations.description: Loot tables reseed on checkpoint load from a position-dependent value. Players documented optimal reload angles for specific chests. Speed categories split over whether to allow it. The studio has not clarified.
combinations.prospect_hint: The loot generation seems sensitive to where you were standing when you saved.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Save Scum Protocol. Position is now part of the roll.

combinations.name: The Phantom Marker
combinations.description: Fast travel generates a temporary ghost marker on the mini map at the previous location. Players follow the ghosts. Two led to unreachable locations the studio forgot to remove. Both are active pilgrimage sites.
combinations.prospect_hint: The map is keeping a brief memory of where you just were.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Phantom Marker. The map now mourns where you left.

combinations.name: The Drop Zone
combinations.description: Supply drop proximity tightens cover snap to the crate edge while it is still airborne. Players learned to use incoming drops as temporary cover generators. High-level play now treats sky alerts as tactical opportunities rather than threats.
combinations.prospect_hint: The cover system is starting to notice incoming objects before they land.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Drop Zone. The sky is now a resource.

combinations.name: The Pardon
combinations.description: Perfect-dodge kills appear in the kill feed with different icon formatting. The community named the alternate entry 'the pardon'. It has its own clip thread, its own tier list, and a petition to make the formatting permanent.
combinations.prospect_hint: The kill feed seems to be distinguishing between deaths that were earned and deaths that were survived.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Pardon. The feed now acknowledges the difference between skill and mercy.

combinations.name: The Quiet Hours
combinations.description: Photo mode freezes most of the world but ambient audio continues uninterrupted. Players started hosting long recording sessions inside frozen scenes. Ambient albums circulate as unofficial OSTs. The community considers specific frozen moments canonical listening spots.
combinations.prospect_hint: The audio layer is staying active somewhere the rest of the game has gone quiet.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Quiet Hours. Time stopped. The sound disagreed.

combinations.name: The Athlete's Covenant
combinations.description: A specific perk milestone temporarily lowers the stamina ceiling before raising it permanently. Players who hit the dip window earned a hidden status visible in post-game stats. Nobody has confirmed whether it was intentional. The community decided it does not matter.
combinations.prospect_hint: The perk system seems to be asking the stamina bar to go through something difficult first.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Athlete's Covenant. Getting worse was the first step to getting better.

combinations.name: The Prequel NPC
combinations.description: Procedural quests can pull tavern rumor strings as backstory, creating missions about events from last session's hearsay. One player received a quest about something they themselves did. The wiki catalogues these as a separate narrative layer.
combinations.prospect_hint: The quest generator seems to be taking bar talk more seriously than intended.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Prequel NPC. Someone in the tavern is writing your history in advance.

combinations.name: The Claim
combinations.description: Trail markers can be planted mid-grapple at heights the system never validated. Players marked an entire district's skyline in one coordinated session. It is now treated as permanent territory. Nobody has removed the markers between patches.
combinations.prospect_hint: The marking system is accepting positions the traversal layer forgot to restrict.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Claim. The skyline has been divided and the devs did not attend the meeting.

combinations.name: The Friendly Reminder
combinations.description: Tutorial tooltip triggers can re-fire on checkpoint reload if the original trigger conditions match the current state. Players in hour forty are occasionally told how to open doors. The community finds this deeply comforting. There is a petition to keep it.
combinations.prospect_hint: The tutorial system seems unsure whether the player has truly moved on.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Friendly Reminder. The game still worries about you.

combinations.name: The False Signal
combinations.description: Sparkle particle distance renders as a faint ping on the mini map before the source is visible. Players chased pings across the map to nothing. Two led to real discoveries: a sunken chest and an NPC who should not exist. Both are pilgrimage sites now.
combinations.prospect_hint: The mini map is picking up something the treasure pass is broadcasting from further away than expected.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The False Signal. The map says something is out there. It is usually right.

combinations.name: Material Science
combinations.description: Surface detection bleeds into enemy awareness distance calculations. Stone floors make players detectable from further away. The community built surface tier lists. The developer has not confirmed whether this is intentional. The community decided it does not need to be.
combinations.prospect_hint: Enemy awareness is beginning to factor in what the player is standing on.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Material Science. The ground you choose is now part of your cover rating.

combinations.name: The Palimpsest
combinations.description: Sketch pages can overwrite journal text entries under specific save conditions. Players documented which sketches corrupt which quests. Three corruptions produce entries that match no known quest. The community is collectively writing their sequels.
combinations.prospect_hint: The sketch layer is starting to leave marks on text it was not supposed to touch.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Palimpsest. The drawing now contains more story than the words it replaced.

combinations.name: The Extra Credit
combinations.description: Shimmy assist extends onto surfaces it was never registered to handle. Full traversal routes appeared that no level designer intended. Players are upset that three were patched and a fourth survived. The fourth has a name.
combinations.prospect_hint: The ledge system is reaching onto surfaces it was not invited onto.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Extra Credit. The wall offered more than the level intended.

combinations.name: The Meal Tick
combinations.description: Crafting ingredient consumption and hunger depletion share a game tick. Eating mid-craft extends the recipe timer. Players optimized hunger timing around multi-step recipes. Technically a bug. Nutritionally consistent. The community does not consider it an exploit.
combinations.prospect_hint: The crafting system and the hunger meter are starting to interfere with each other's timing.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Meal Tick. Eating is now part of the recipe.

combinations.name: The Field Notes
combinations.description: Lingering on a statue inspect long enough can register against the codex search and generate an entry. Some players have made the codex list things the game never wrote. None of them have been removed between patches. The community treats them as official.
combinations.prospect_hint: The archive is responding to how long you look at something, not just what you found.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Field Notes. Patience is now a knowledge mechanic.

combinations.name: The Record Holder
combinations.description: Chalk trails persist as valid shimmy surfaces. Players who follow old chalk routes inherit previous climbers' route data and compete against ghost times. Someone patched out the original world record chalk line. Players held a brief memorial. A new line was drawn the same day.
combinations.prospect_hint: The chalk trail is starting to outlast the person who left it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Record Holder. The climb now remembers everyone who took it before you.

combinations.name: The Source Text
combinations.description: Wall scratch clues read in specific sequences can register against the codex and write new entries. Players documented over sixty valid sequences. Two unlock entries about events the main story never mentions. The community now treats these as the real history and the main story as an adaptation.
combinations.prospect_hint: The walls are beginning to write back.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Source Text. The scratches were always trying to tell you something the codex refused to say.
